concerns.text: Task T015 is marked as rejected/missing, yet Spec FR-001 and Plan Task 0.3 mandate a hard stop or explicit warning if subject retention drops below 80% due to missing behavioral data. The task list fails to preserve this critical constraint, leaving the pipeline without a defined failure condition for data completeness.

Plan Task 1.3 and Spec FR-002.1 mandate aggregating centrality from a 'fixed, a priori set of regions' (indices 1-10) to avoid bias. Task T020 explicitly instructs calculating metrics for 'ALL regions (~90 nodes)' before T020.5 extracts the subset. This semantic drift undermines the bias-control strategy by processing the full atlas unnecessarily and creating a dependency on a post-hoc extraction rather than a priori selection.

Spec Edge Cases and Plan Task 1.6 require the system to detect VIF > 5 and switch to PCA components. Task T022 is marked as rejected/missing, leaving the 'Single Source of Truth' for model predictors undefined in the event of multicollinearity, violating the requirement to handle collinearity without silent failure.

Plan Task 1.4 requires calculating Mean Framewise Displacement (FD) for motion control. Task T021 is rejected/missing, meaning the required motion covariate cannot be included in the regression models (T024), violating the constraint to control for motion confounds.

Spec FR-004 and Plan Task 3.1 require a Freedman-Lane permutation test permuting the residuals of the null model. Task T030 is rejected/missing and the description notes it uses 'first residual' instead of the primary coefficient logic, failing to preserve the statistical validation constraint.

Spec FR-005 and Plan Task 3.2 require 5-fold cross-validation with R² and RMSE metrics compared against a baseline. Task T031 is rejected/missing, failing to preserve the validation constraint required to assess out-of-sample prediction accuracy.

Plan Task 1.1 mandates fMRIPrep preprocessing. Tasks T019 and T020 are rejected/missing (containing NotImplementedError stubs), blocking the generation of required connectivity matrices and centrality metrics, which violates the constraint to process data using fMRIPrep and AAL3 atlas.

Spec FR-003 requires fitting a linear regression model with specific covariates. Task T024 is rejected/missing (truncated code), preventing the verification of the primary hypothesis and violating the functional requirement to fit the model.
